messages:
Alex Chen: FYI — Nova Enterprises is ready for their Dedicated cutover. Proposed change window: Wed 2026-03-25 21:00-22:00 PT. Need infra + CS signoff and deploybot schedule.
Priya Kapoor: Confirming infra readiness. We'll pin runtime to rdx-runtime@1.14.0 and model to open-mistral-v2:ff3a2. Can we do a 30m canary (10% traffic) then full 100% at +30m?
Maria Gomez: CS checked with customer, they want a 15-min canary first, then 45m full. They also need audit logs forwarded to their SIEM.
Lisa Park (CS): Customer provided signed cutover approval doc in Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/Nova/cutover-approval
Tom Ryan: Oncall available for the window. I'll set up pager and increase log retention. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.example/dedicated-cutover
Deploy Bot: Deployment job queued by @alex_chen — job id 8f3c2e. Targets: nova-dedicated-prod, capacity pool B. Planned actions:
```
redwoodctl rollout start --customer nova --target nova-dedicated-prod --version rdx-runtime@1.14.0 --model open-mistral-v2:ff3a2 --canary 10% --wait 1800
```
Prior to kick: confirm rollback image sha and fallback policy.
Priya Kapoor: Rollback plan: immediate rollback to rdx-runtime@1.13.8 (sha: b7c9d1). If canary errors exceed 2% 5xx or latency > 250ms p50 -> auto-rollback. I'll attach the pinned versions to release notes.
Alex Chen: I've uploaded release notes + change log: https://docs.redwood.example/releases/nova-1.14.0
Lisa Park (CS): +1 from customer for Wed 21:00 PT. They accept the 15m/45m split. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: Noted. I've added SIEM forwarding to their account and set retention to 90d.
Tom Ryan: I'll be on-call at 20:30 for prechecks. @deploy-bot please schedule the job for 21:00 PT and send a 15m pre-notice.
Deploy Bot: Job scheduled. Pre-notice will be posted at 20:45 PT. Job id 8f3c2e scheduled for 2026-03-25T21:00:00-07:00. Monitoring hooks: latency, error-rate, kv-cache hit-rate.
Alex Chen: Final check — anyone blocking? If not I'll mark this as approved and start the preflight checklist at 20:45.
Priya Kapoor: All good from infra. Approving rollout. :white_check_mark:
Lisa Park (CS): Customer approves. :white_check_mark:
Tom Ryan: Oncall ready. :rotating_light:
Maria Gomez: I'll be watching CS channel for any customer comments.
Deploy Bot: Preflight started at 2026-03-25T20:45:00-07:00 — checks: config-sync OK, capacity OK, model checksum OK.
Deploy Bot: Canary rollout complete at 2026-03-25T21:15:12-07:00 — 10% traffic. Metrics: 5xx 0.4%, p50 120ms. Proceeding to full rollout.
Deploy Bot: Full rollout complete at 2026-03-25T21:47:03-07:00 — job id 8f3c2e. No rollbacks triggered. :tada:
Alex Chen: Closing thread. Great job team.
